question: Which city hosted the SAFF Championship 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangalore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• South Asian Football Federation Championship:-

 
 
• It is the main international association football competition of the men's national football teams governed by the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF).
 
• All eight teams are eligible to compete in the tournament.
 
• The SAFF Championship was first held in 1993 in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
 
• India is the most successful team in the tournament's history, having won the title nine times.
 
• Bangladesh is the second most successful team, having won the title three times.
 
• The SAFF Championship is held every two years.
 
 
 
• 2023 SAFF Championship:-
 
 
• It will be hosted by Bangalore, India. 
 
• The tournament will be held from June 21 to July 4, 2023, at the Sree Kanteerava Stadium.
 
• India was originally not supposed to host the tournament, but was awarded the hosting rights after Sri Lanka was suspended by FIFA.
 
• Nepal was the only other country that had applied to host the tournament.
